proof_body:
by
  intro a e x y ha he hne
  have hk : 1 - e ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hne
    have : e ^ 2 = 1 ^ 2 := by linarith
    exact (pow_left_inj₀ he.le zero_le_one two_ne_zero).mp this
  have hr : e * |x - a / e| = Real.sqrt ((e * x - a) ^ 2) := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs, ← abs_of_pos he, ← abs_mul, abs_of_pos he]
    congr 1
    field_simp
  rw [hr, Real.sqrt_inj (by positivity) (by positivity)]
  constructor
  · intro h
    field_simp
    linear_combination h
  · intro h
    field_simp at h
    linear_combination h
